quests.passage: Within a week, the new neighbor had knocked on every door on the street, friendly enough to already know most people's first names.
quests.question: kind and pleasant toward other people
quests.hint: Notice how quickly she got to know the whole street.
quests.explanation: 'Friendly' describes being warm and easy to get along with. Introducing herself to the entire street in a week shows how sociable she is.
quests.wordInContext: The staff at the small hotel were so friendly that guests often came back year after year.

quests.passage: Before the final exam, Leah's hands felt cold and she kept flipping through her notes one more time, too nervous to sit still.
quests.question: worried or anxious about something that is about to happen
quests.hint: Think about her hands and why she can't stop checking her notes.
quests.explanation: 'Nervous' describes feeling worried or uneasy, often before something important. Leah's cold hands and constant rechecking show her anxiety.
quests.wordInContext: He felt nervous before the job interview and arrived twenty minutes early just in case.

quests.passage: Two years into the job, her plan was still ambitious: become regional manager before anyone else in her hiring group.
quests.question: having a strong desire to achieve success or a difficult goal
quests.hint: Notice the size of the goal she has set for such a short timeframe.
quests.explanation: 'Ambitious' describes having strong drive toward a challenging goal. Aiming for a manager role in only two years shows high ambition.
quests.wordInContext: Their ambitious plan was to open five new stores within a single year.

quests.passage: The train's climb into the mountains was gradual, rising so slowly that most passengers never felt the altitude change.
quests.question: happening slowly over time, not suddenly
quests.hint: Think about why the passengers didn't notice the change.
quests.explanation: 'Gradual' describes something that happens in small, slow steps rather than all at once. The unnoticed climb shows how slow the change was.
quests.wordInContext: Her English improved gradually over two years of watching shows without subtitles.

quests.passage: Uncle Raj never came to visit empty-handed; generous as always, he'd slip a little extra pocket money to each niece and nephew.
quests.question: willing to give more than what is expected, especially money or time
quests.hint: Notice what Uncle Raj does every single visit.
quests.explanation: 'Generous' describes someone who freely gives more than necessary. Regularly handing out extra pocket money shows this quality clearly.
quests.wordInContext: The restaurant owner was generous with the leftover bread, giving it to anyone who asked at closing time.

quests.passage: The department store's new collection used luxurious fabrics, priced well above anything in the everyday clothing section.
quests.question: expensive and of very high quality, often linked with comfort or wealth
quests.hint: Compare the price of this collection to regular clothing.
quests.explanation: 'Luxurious' describes something rich, high-quality, and expensive, often associated with comfort. The steep price difference points to this.
quests.wordInContext: Their hotel suite felt luxurious, with silk sheets and a view of the entire bay.

quests.passage: Alongside its usual sweet treats, the bakery began selling a savory pastry stuffed with cheese and herbs instead of sugar and fruit.
quests.question: having a salty or spicy taste rather than a sweet one
quests.hint: Compare this new pastry to the bakery's usual sweet options.
quests.explanation: 'Savory' describes food that tastes salty or spicy rather than sweet. The cheese and herb filling, unlike sugar or fruit, marks this pastry as savory.
quests.wordInContext: He prefers savory breakfasts, like eggs and toast, over sweet ones like pancakes.

quests.passage: Once the company switched to a faster, cloud-based system, the old software became obsolete and no one installed it again.
quests.question: no longer useful because something newer has replaced it
quests.hint: Think about what happened to the old software once the new system arrived.
quests.explanation: 'Obsolete' describes something outdated and replaced by something newer. Nobody using the old software anymore shows it has become obsolete.
quests.wordInContext: Floppy disks became obsolete once USB drives and cloud storage took over.

quests.passage: Looking after three young children all day left her exhausting evenings, and by dinnertime she barely had energy to sit up.
quests.question: causing someone to feel extremely tired
quests.hint: Notice how she feels by the end of the day and why.
quests.explanation: 'Exhausting' describes an activity that drains a person's energy completely. Struggling to sit up by evening shows how draining her day was.
quests.wordInContext: Moving apartments in one weekend turned out to be more exhausting than either of them expected.

quests.passage: The mystery novel turned out to be so gripping that she ignored her alarm and kept reading past midnight to finish the last chapter.
quests.question: holding someone's attention completely, hard to stop reading or watching
quests.hint: Think about what she chose to do instead of sleeping.
quests.explanation: 'Gripping' describes something that holds your attention so strongly you can't stop. Ignoring the alarm to keep reading shows the book's grip on her.
quests.wordInContext: The trial's final witness gave gripping testimony that silenced the entire courtroom.

quests.passage: Papers, folders, and old coffee cups had taken over his desk, so cluttered that he couldn't find the report he needed underneath it all.
quests.question: filled untidily with too many things
quests.hint: Notice why he can't locate a specific document.
quests.explanation: 'Cluttered' describes a space filled with too many things in a disorganized way. His inability to find the report among the mess shows this clutter.
quests.wordInContext: The garage had grown so cluttered over the years that the car barely fit inside.

quests.passage: Rather than cram the night before an exam, the diligent student reviewed her notes every evening, topic by topic, weeks ahead of time.
quests.question: showing careful, steady effort in work or study
quests.hint: Think about her study habits compared to leaving things until the last minute.
quests.explanation: 'Diligent' describes putting in steady, careful effort over time rather than rushing. Reviewing notes nightly for weeks shows this consistent effort.
quests.wordInContext: His diligent research meant the report had almost no factual errors.

quests.passage: When the printer jammed minutes before the meeting, the resourceful assistant simply emailed everyone the slides instead.
quests.question: good at finding quick, practical solutions to problems
quests.hint: Notice how the assistant solved the printer problem.
quests.explanation: 'Resourceful' describes someone skilled at solving problems with what's available. Switching to email instead of panicking shows resourcefulness.
quests.wordInContext: Stranded without a phone charger, he was resourceful enough to borrow one from a stranger at the gate.

quests.passage: Tucked into such a remote valley, the cabin sat a full two-hour drive from the nearest town.
quests.question: far from towns or cities; hard to reach
quests.hint: Think about how far the nearest town actually is from this cabin.
quests.explanation: 'Remote' describes a place that is far away and isolated. A two-hour drive to the nearest town shows just how isolated this valley is.
quests.wordInContext: The research team spent six months studying wildlife in a remote part of the rainforest.

quests.passage: Once his grandmother had gone to bed, her considerate son quietly turned the television volume down without being asked.
quests.question: thinking about other people's needs and feelings before acting
quests.hint: Notice what the son does without anyone reminding him.
quests.explanation: 'Considerate' describes thinking of others' comfort before your own convenience. Lowering the volume unprompted shows he's thinking of his grandmother.
quests.wordInContext: It was considerate of her to save a seat for the coworker who was running late.

quests.passage: Tourists soon learned to avoid the souvenir shop near the museum, known locally for overpriced postcards that cost triple the going rate.
quests.question: priced much higher than something is actually worth
quests.hint: Compare the shop's prices to what postcards usually cost.
quests.explanation: 'Overpriced' describes something costing far more than its real value. Charging triple the normal rate is a clear sign of this.
quests.wordInContext: The bottled water at the stadium was so overpriced that fans started bringing their own from home.

quests.passage: The community kitchen served wholesome meals, cooked entirely from vegetables grown a few streets away in the neighborhood garden.
quests.question: good for your health, made from natural ingredients
quests.hint: Notice where the ingredients for these meals come from.
quests.explanation: 'Wholesome' describes food that is healthy and made simply, without processed shortcuts. Fresh, local vegetables fit this description well.
quests.wordInContext: Her grandmother always cooked wholesome dinners, nothing from a package or a can.

quests.passage: The building's new security system relied on an advanced camera network able to recognize faces even in near darkness.
quests.question: using modern, highly developed technology or methods
quests.hint: Think about what makes this camera system stand out from an ordinary one.
quests.explanation: 'Advanced' describes technology or methods that are highly developed and go beyond the basics. Recognizing faces in low light shows this is far from a simple camera setup.
quests.wordInContext: The hospital installed advanced scanning equipment that can detect problems doctors used to miss.

quests.passage: Daily stretching, recommended by his physiotherapist, was how he managed his chronic back pain, a problem that never fully went away.
quests.question: continuing for a long time; not easily cured
quests.hint: Notice how long this back problem has lasted and how he deals with it, not cures it.
quests.explanation: 'Chronic' describes a condition that lasts a long time, often something managed rather than fixed. The ongoing pain, treated daily instead of cured, fits this.
quests.wordInContext: The city has struggled with chronic traffic problems for over a decade.

quests.passage: The documentary's final episode was fascinating enough that no one in the room reached for their phone, not even once.
quests.question: extremely interesting, capturing someone's full attention
quests.hint: Think about what everyone did, or didn't do, while watching.
quests.explanation: 'Fascinating' describes something so interesting it fully absorbs your attention. Nobody checking their phone shows the episode's grip on the viewers.
quests.wordInContext: She found the history of the old silk road fascinating and read three books about it.

quests.passage: Travelers passing through the small village always mentioned how hospitable it felt, with tea offered to nearly every stranger who wandered in.
quests.question: friendly and welcoming to guests or visitors
quests.hint: Notice how the village treats people who are just passing through.
quests.explanation: 'Hospitable' describes being warm and welcoming toward guests. Offering tea to almost any visitor shows the village's welcoming nature.
quests.wordInContext: The family was so hospitable that they insisted the lost hikers stay for dinner.

quests.passage: Taking detailed notes, the attentive students caught every example the professor gave, even the small ones mentioned only once.
quests.question: paying close attention to what is happening
quests.hint: Notice how much detail these students managed to record.
quests.explanation: 'Attentive' describes focusing carefully on something without missing details. Catching every example, even the brief ones, shows careful attention.
quests.wordInContext: The waiter was attentive all evening, refilling water glasses before anyone had to ask.

quests.passage: The new employee was versatile enough to switch between marketing, scheduling, and customer calls, handling each with equal ease.
quests.question: able to do many different things well
quests.hint: Think about how many different tasks this employee can manage.
quests.explanation: 'Versatile' describes being skilled across a range of different tasks. Handling three unrelated jobs with equal ease shows real versatility.
quests.wordInContext: This jacket is versatile enough to wear hiking, at the office, or out for dinner.

quests.passage: Photographers traveled far to capture the picturesque fishing village, drawn to its colorful boats and narrow, winding streets.
quests.question: visually charming or attractive, like a painting
quests.hint: Notice what specifically draws photographers to this village.
quests.explanation: 'Picturesque' describes a place that is attractive enough to look like a painting or photograph. The colorful boats and narrow streets create that visual charm.
quests.wordInContext: The picturesque vineyard on the hillside appeared in dozens of travel magazines.

quests.passage: The moment his sister started walking to school alone, her older brother grew protective, calling to check she'd arrived safely.
quests.question: wanting to keep someone safe from harm
quests.hint: Think about what changed in the brother's behavior once she started walking alone.
quests.explanation: 'Protective' describes a strong desire to guard someone from danger. Calling to make sure she arrived safely shows this protective instinct.
quests.wordInContext: New parents tend to be especially protective during a baby's first few months.

quests.passage: The salesperson recommended the leather bag over the canvas one, pointing out it was far more durable and would survive years of daily use.
quests.question: able to last a long time without breaking or wearing out
quests.hint: Compare the two bags and think about which one lasts longer.
quests.explanation: 'Durable' describes something built to withstand wear and last a long time. Surviving years of daily use is exactly what makes leather durable here.
quests.wordInContext: The company markets its phone cases as durable enough to survive a drop from waist height.

quests.passage: Without any salt or seasoning, the rice tasted bland, so flat that she reached straight for the pepper.
quests.question: having little or no flavor; not interesting to taste
quests.hint: Think about why she immediately wanted to add something.
quests.explanation: 'Bland' describes food that lacks flavor or interest. Reaching for pepper right away shows the rice needed more taste.
quests.wordInContext: Hospital food has a reputation for being bland, cooked with almost no seasoning at all.

quests.passage: Before buying the printer, he made sure it was compatible with his laptop's operating system, since an older model wouldn't have worked at all.
quests.question: able to work together with something else without problems
quests.hint: Notice what he checked before making the purchase.
quests.explanation: 'Compatible' describes two things able to work together properly. Checking the operating system first shows he needed a printer that would actually work with his laptop.
quests.wordInContext: Not every charger is compatible with every phone brand, so she always checks first.

quests.passage: After the night shift, the paramedics looked fatigued, their eyelids heavy from hours spent without a single break.
quests.question: very tired, often after a long period of effort
quests.hint: Think about what a night shift with no break would do to someone.
quests.explanation: 'Fatigued' is a more formal way of saying extremely tired, often used for physical or mental exhaustion after sustained effort. The heavy eyelids after hours without rest show this state clearly.
quests.wordInContext: Long-haul pilots are trained to recognize when they've become too fatigued to fly safely.

quests.passage: The ballet's final scene was magical enough that several people in the audience were quietly wiping away tears as the lights came up.
quests.question: so beautiful or wonderful that it feels almost unreal
quests.hint: Notice how the audience reacted as the performance ended.
quests.explanation: 'Magical' describes something so beautiful or moving that it feels enchanting, almost beyond the ordinary. People in tears at the final scene shows its powerful effect.
quests.wordInContext: Watching the northern lights for the first time felt magical, nothing like the photos she'd seen.
